This is done by first flipping the largest unsorted element to the front of the list and then flipping the entire unsorted portion of the list to move the largest element to its correct position.     while start < i:
        arr[start], arr[i] = arr[i], arr[start]
        start += 1
        i -= 1

    for i in range(1, n):
        if arr[i] > arr[max_idx]:
            max_idx = i
    return max_idx

    n = len(arr)

    inc = arr[:]
    dec = arr[:]
